content: {"reasoning":"The missing required authorization caused CO-197, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been filed, but no current payer response is available, so another appeal or an information response is not supported. The deductible alone does not establish patient liability for the authorization denial, and writing off is premature while the appeal remains unresolved; a specialist must check its status because no available automated action can properly progress the claim.","action":"escalate"}
